answer: Each agent earns a unique opal token bound to its hardware fingerprint, staked as collateral. Every epoch, the network samples a random pulse challenge; agents must sign it within a tight window and pay gas, making mass fake identities costly. Rewards unlock only when a lotus maturity proof confirms sustained, distinct participation. Sybils must fund thousands of staked opals and answer every pulse, so attack cost grows linearly while honest single agents stay inexpensive. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
